summary: Frontend E2E smoke test of Childeric (Expo/RN, 100% local, French). Reset localStorage → Onboarding → Bilan (all 51 questions) → Plan creation → Tabs (Aujourd'hui/Plan/Suivi/Réglages) → Delete flow. All critical flows work. plan-create-button correctly disables/enables based on required fields; bilan-prev-button disabled on first question; last bilan button becomes 'Terminer'; add-action/add-objective, day chips, mood, note, close-day all working; export & delete bottom sheet render correct testIDs. Two non-blocking observations reported below.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted twice at app load. Likely coming from a library or an internal component. Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents. Reference: search codebase for pointerEvents=<value> usage.

action_items: (Optional) Grep the codebase for `pointerEvents=` and migrate to `style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }}` to silence the deprecation warning (RN 0.74+/Expo SDK 57).
critical_code_review_comments: plan-create.tsx uses a module-level `let counter = 0` for id generation — fine for a single mount but could collide across hot reloads; acceptable for MVP.
onboarding.tsx: canStart only checks firstName; reminderTime has a safe default. OK.
bilan.tsx: firstUnanswered memoized with empty deps intentionally (documented via eslint-disable). Good.
seed_data_creation: None. Reset via localStorage.clear() before onboarding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested with viewport 390x844 on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. To reset state, run `await page.evaluate(() => window.localStorage.clear())` then reload. Bilan has 51 questions and answers are optional (fastest path = click bilan-next-button 51 times). After plan creation, the Aujourd'hui tab may show 0 action cards if none of the selected weekdays match today; select all 7 days when creating actions in tests that need to interact with action cards. During Réglages retest, re-opening the delete BottomSheetModal immediately after dismiss can time out — add ~800ms wait after dismiss before re-presenting.
